stepNotes.1: 33-line module, 3 exports; 7 route modules consume it (session-impl, graph, audit, dre-graph, super-long, tui, route-params) — shared critical-path guard, not a leaf.
stepNotes.2: Three failure modes traced through server/error.ts: 404 via NotFoundError for missing rows, 409 via HTTPException for cross-project conflict mapped to retryable ServiceUnavailableError, happy path returns Info or id.
stepNotes.3: assertSessionExists relies on Session.get throwing NotFoundError for both no-row and unparseable-row cases (session/index.ts:470-472); requireCurrentProjectSession delegates to isCompatibleWithCurrentProject (projectID + directory overlap); parseCurrentProjectSessionID returns the verified id rather than the raw route param by design.
stepNotes.4: Each helper does at most one primary-key indexed SQLite read; no loops, no fan-out; O(1) per request on every session route — no memoization or batching opportunity.
stepNotes.5: Three-function ladder (existence -> existence+ownership -> route-bound+ownership) is well-factored; mild bidirectional import cycle between session-lookup.ts and route-params.ts via assertSessionExists, which dissolves if that export is removed.
stepNotes.6: assertSessionExists (session-lookup.ts:6-8) has one caller — parseExistingSessionID (route-params.ts:40) — which itself has zero production callers and is policed away by session-messages.test.ts:379; transitively dead, and it offers the existence-without-ownership bypass this module exists to prevent.
stepNotes.7: No direct unit test; only structural source-text assertions in session-messages.test.ts:362-400 enforce which helper is wired into session-impl.ts routes; no behavioral test of the 409 or 404 paths through these helpers.
stepNotes.8: Four findings: MEDIUM dead guard-bypassing assertSessionExists export, LOW 409->retryable-ServiceUnavailableError mismatch, LOW existence oracle via raw sessionID in 409 message, LOW missing behavioral tests; no Critical.
stepNotes.9: findings/ empty and no Critical raised so no reverify.md second pass; gate is typecheck + session-messages.test.ts after removing assertSessionExists; finding 1 is the only action item this wave.
